title: Activate updates through controlled reload
description: Announce a waiting service-worker update and activate it only after open changes are durable and the user explicitly accepts a controlled reload.
acceptanceCriteria: A waiting service worker produces a visible and programmatically announced update notice
The application never reloads automatically over a non-durable open change
Accepting an update first verifies or completes draft durability
The waiting worker activates and the page reloads only after durability succeeds
A failed save blocks activation and provides an actionable retry path

steps.details: Translate service-worker lifecycle events into typed host state for no update, update waiting, activation requested, and activation failed.
Show a non-color-only status message with explicit Update now and Later actions; announce availability without stealing focus.
Before messaging the waiting worker to activate, await the project repository's durable-draft operation; keep the current page open if persistence rejects.
After the new worker controls the page, reload exactly once and clear transient activation state to prevent loops.
Simulate a waiting worker with both successful and failed durability, asserting that only the successful explicit path activates and reloads.

technicalNotes: Keep service-worker messaging in the host layer rather than domain modules.
Treat a pending write as non-durable even if current UI state looks complete.
